h: Love and Fear Complete Each Other at Their Root

p: מַה שֶּׁתָּפַס בְּמִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ
what Midrash Rabbah at the beginning of this parsha says
this is the Shabbos of Erev Shabbos";
and the Shabbos of Erev Shabbos
means the Master of your powers;
that is, when it is in completeness,
as at the Giving of the Torah,
in it is Kesser and in it is Ayin
and this is as is written in the holy Zohar
and Kesser Elyon is the crown of Malchus";
Havayah, the Master of your powers,
is when it comes from complete love,
"My fear comes from within my joy."
And this is why the Midrash specified
and his completeness was at the Akeidah,
the Holy One, blessed be He,
this teaches that he acted out of love";
that is, in the completeness of his fear,
And this is what is said,
that the fear be from within love.
the secret of the letter Vav-Vav,
was a chariot for the Name Havayah,
like Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and it is the aspect of mercy.
"My fear comes from within my joy":
is when it comes through fear,
is when it comes from within love
